source_card: Original APK reference HUD: thin silver stepped bars, circular gold filigree portrait/button rims, dark-blue chat/menu fields, tilted blue oval action buttons. Reference UI.png has asymmetric gold leaf curls around a flat blue center. These are content identities; Octopath palette and crisp pixel clustering are the redraw direction. Pet sheets supply pixel edge compatibility only.
